synthetic_long_horizon_tracking.description: Scaled synthetic long-horizon tactile tracking benchmark, anchored to the paper's Table IV tracking MAE trends. Translation is reported in millimeters using the GelSight Mini pixel pitch implied by 320x240 images over a 20mm x 15mm sensing area.

rotation_mae_deg.description: Mean rotational pose error over the evaluated slice; lower values indicate better tactile tracking.

translation_mae_mm.description: Mean translational pose error in millimeters over the evaluated slice; lower values indicate better tactile tracking.

rotation_p95_deg.description: Ninety-fifth percentile rotational error, included to catch localized drift spikes hidden by mean error.

translation_p95_mm.description: Ninety-fifth percentile translational error, included to catch localized drift spikes hidden by mean error.

terminal_rotation_error_deg.description: Rotational error at the last frame in the slice, probing accumulated long-horizon drift.

terminal_translation_error_mm.description: Translational error at the last frame in the slice, probing accumulated long-horizon drift.

loop_closure_quality.description: Loop-closure behavior for the scaled synthetic benchmark, anchored to Table II tracking statistics and the paper's qualitative requirement that accepted loops be valid.

accepted_loops.description: Number of accepted loop closures in the evaluated slice; retained as a weak productivity signal.

valid_loops.description: Accepted loop closures whose measured relative pose agrees with the ground-truth revisit relation.

false_loop_rate.description: Fraction of accepted loop closures that violate the ground-truth revisit relation; this penalizes unsafe loop acceptance.
